audit.whatIsWrong: Talon's R called 'Shadow Assassin' in spikes[1] and whys[4]; Pantheon's E called 'Aegis of Valor' in spikes[0] (real name Aegis Assault); cooldowns field had no digits; dos/donts bodies were pasted trade lines.
audit.why: Kit file is authoritative: Shield Vault 13s rank 1, Aegis Assault 22s, Comet Spear 11s, Grand Starfall 180s.
audit.corrected: Names fixed, real cooldowns added, pasted bullets replaced with matching bodies.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): matchup-defining — Point-and-click stun — respect the all-in any time it is up. It governs your forward steps. - E Assassin's Path spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault (Stun): a 13s point-and-click stun at rank 1 — respect the all-in whenever it's up. - His E Aegis Assault runs 22 seconds — a spent shield is a twenty-second kill window. - E Assassin's Path spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

notes: Full layer had Pantheon winning all seven rows while content win[] and the packet both give Talon all seven — aligned full to the data with content-grounded whys. The full prose (tldr, winCon, diff HARD 8/10) still frames the lane as Pantheon-favored; I did not rewrite that framing wholesale because the safe-side reality (his level 1-2 spear window, W point-and-click stun) is genuinely dangerous and the prose stays useful — but diff vs chart tension is flagged as a question. Missing interactions: E denying his W/R dashes is Talon's E creating terrain — plausible but the wall-dash-block interaction vs a point-and-click W is not verifiable from kit text alone; left unwritten and recorded as unverified.
